article_summaries.title: Create New Items for the Free Realms Marketplace!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announces Player Studio, a program letting US-based players aged 18 and up design new in-game items (with a name, description and storyline rationale) for possible sale in the SOE Marketplace. Selected items are priced in Station Cash, and designers share the revenue. The post gives no exact date; it is shown as posted about one month before the December 2012 capture.

article_summaries.title: Forge Amazing Weapons with Player Studio!
article_summaries.summary: An official freerealms.com news post announcing that Player Studio, a program inviting (initially US-based) players to design items, is now accepting submissions of player-created weapons (axes, swords, hammers, wands). Selected designs would be sold in the SOE Marketplace for Station Cash, with revenue shared back to the creator. The post gives no exact date, only a relative 'posted 3 months, 4 days ago' stamp.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Player Studio FAQ
article_summaries.summary: This SOE FAQ page describes the Player Studio program, in which players design in-game items for sale in the SOE Marketplace and receive a share of sales. Free Realms is one of four SOE games listed as slated to kick off the program, with more details promised at SOE Live (October 18-21, 2012). The page describes a planned program and does not detail any Free Realms item, quest or mechanic.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Player Studio
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com program page announcing Player Studio, where players design new in-game items using sample geometry, write a name, description and storyline rationale, and submit them. Selected items are sold in the SOE Marketplace priced in Station Cash, with revenue shared with the creator. The page gives no date, and the client text table has many 'Created by ... for Player Studio!' item descriptions, showing the program did ship items.
